skipped_manual: B01: rewritten as an assertion over an artefact this design-only build actually produces. PermissionSetAssignment is record data, not metadata, so no artefact here can record who holds the permission. Given the bypass exists to let API-created cases skip the Case validation rules, when permissionsets/Case_Intake_Integration.permissionset-meta.xml is read, then it grants Bypass_Case_Intake_Validation and nothing else — no objectPermissions, no fieldPermissions, no userPermissions — and deploy-order.md carries the post-deploy instruction that this permission set is assigned to the integration/automated-process identity only and to no human user, with a named owner for that assignment.
